subject: Kickoff: Renewal + Expansion MAP for ClearWave Analytics — roles, timeline, next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@clearwave.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Renewal + Expansion MAP for ClearWave Analytics — roles, timeline, next steps

Hi Ava & team —

Thanks again for the productive renewal discussion last week. As discussed, we've put together a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on the renewal and the expansion add-on for dedicated capacity (10 additional reserved nodes). Primary goals for this MAP:

- Confirm commercial terms and amendment path for expansion
- Complete usage deep-dive to validate sizing and trial quota
- Surface any security/compliance evidence needed for procurement
- Target contract execution to enable April 1, 2026 start for expanded capacity

I've attached a first-pass MAP (ClearWave_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) and a usage export (usage_export_q4_2025.csv) to ground the sizing conversation. High-level proposed timeline (draft):

1) Week of Feb 15 — MAP kickoff meeting (30m): confirm stakeholders, owners, and critical path
2) Feb 16–23 — Usage deep-dive and sizing validation (owner: Marissa)
3) Feb 24–Mar 5 — Procurement & legal review; security questionnaire as needed (owner: Nikhil)
4) Mar 8–20 — Finalize amendment & pricing, internal approvals (owners: Diego + Marissa)
5) Target signature by Mar 31 to enable April 1 go-live

Please confirm the right stakeholders (below) and 30-minute slots that work for a kickoff next week. Suggested times (PST):
- Tue Feb 16 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed Feb 17 09:30–10:00 or 14:00–14:30

Roles (proposed):
- Redwood exec sponsor / deal owner: Diego Fernandez
- Redwood technical lead (usage & sizing): Marissa Cole
- Redwood security/compliance: Nikhil Sharma
- ClearWave exec sponsor: Ava Morgan
- ClearWave engineering lead: Liam O'Neal
- ClearWave procurement: procurement@clearwave.com

Ask: Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether ClearWave requires a formal SOC2 package or a lighter evidence bundle? Also flag any additional stakeholders we should include in the kickoff.

Attachments: ClearWave_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), usage_export_q4_2025.csv (token/usage extract)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning and keeping this timeline tight.

Best,

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: diego.fernandez@redwood.inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189
--
Note: internal owners looped for visibility.
From: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@clearwave.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@clearwave.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearwave.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal + Expansion MAP for ClearWave Analytics — roles, timeline, next steps

Diego —

Thanks for the clear plan. We're aligned on most of this and appreciate the proposed timeline. A few quick updates from our side:

- Adding two stakeholders to the kickoff: Liam O'Neal (VP Eng) — he will own technical acceptance, and Sana Kapoor (Head of Data Ops) will join for ops questions. I'll introduce them formally if they need calendar invites.
- Procurement contact is procurement@clearwave.com (copied). They'll need the final amendment and the SOC2 evidence; if you can send a condensed evidence bundle that would help speed review.
- On capacity: the business is comfortable with the proposed +10 nodes, but we need a short proof window (30 days) post-activation to validate cost/perf. Can Redwood provide a short trial SLA for the expansion window?

Availability for the kickoff: Tue Feb 16 15:00–15:30 PST works for Liam and me. Please send the invite.

Also sending over an internal DocuSign request for a previous amendment (AMND-2025-88) — I can point procurement to it once we have the updated terms.

Best,
Ava
Director, Product Partnerships
ClearWave Analytics

On Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 9:12 AM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Hi Ava & team —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive renewal discussion last week. As discussed, we've put together a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) ...
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@clearwave.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.inference>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearwave.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal + Expansion MAP for ClearWave Analytics — roles, timeline, next steps

Ava / team —

Appreciate the quick responses and the added stakeholders. I'll take point on the usage deep-dive next week. Proposed pre-work for our session (aim to keep kickoff to 30 minutes):

- ClearWave to confirm list of evaluation goals (latency targets, tail-latency SLOs, cost per 10k tokens, throughput targets for peak batch windows) — send in reply or add to the shared doc
- Redwood to prepare a short usage breakdown (we have the attached CSV) with recommended quantization and caching profiles to meet target costs
- Nikhil will attach an evidence bundle (SOC2 summary + network architecture diagram) and list any open security questions for procurement

Owners & short checklist:
- Usage deep-dive (owner: Marissa Cole) — deliverable: one-slide sizing + recommended config
- Security evidence + questionnaire (owner: Nikhil Sharma) — deliverable: evidence bundle + remaining ask list
- Commercial amendment draft (owner: Diego) — deliverable: amendment draft + redlines
- Procurement coordination (owner: ClearWave procurement) — deliverable: procurement timeline + PO process notes

I'll update the MAP doc with the owners and send a calendar invite for Tue Feb 16 15:00 PST. Diego — can you include the trial-SLA language Ava requested (30-day validation period) in the MAP before the kickoff?

Thanks,
Rachel
Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: ClearWave_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (updated with owner column)

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal + Expansion MAP for ClearWave Analytics — roles, timeline, next steps

Ava / Liam / procurement —

Thanks — calendar invite is sent for Tue Feb 16 15:00 PST. I've updated the MAP to call out the 30-day validation trial-SLA (we'll provide monitoring dashboards and a cost reconciliation report at day 30; if ClearWave finds a material perf/cost regression we will pause billing on the expanded capacity while we remediate). See the MAP link and attached amendment pointer (amendment_docusign_link.txt) for procurement.

Confirmed milestones (updated):
- Feb 16: Kickoff (30m) — confirm owners / acceptance criteria (Marissa to present usage)
- Feb 17–23: Sizing & config recommendations (deliverable: one-slide sizing + token cost estimate)
- Feb 24–Mar 5: Security evidence + procurement Q&A (deliverable: evidence bundle + procurement checklist)
- Mar 8–Mar 20: Final amendment redlines + budget approvals
- Mar 31: Target signature (to enable Apr 1 activation)

Next steps from us before the kickoff:
1) Finalize and attach condensed SOC2 evidence (Nikhil)
2) Marissa to prepare the 1-slide sizing and cost breakdown from the CSV
3) Diego to add trial-SLA wording to the amendment (done) and share the DocuSign pointer for procurement (attached)

Attachments: amendment_docusign_link.txt (DocuSign transaction link), ClearWave_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (updated with owners)

If procurement needs a faster path we can prepare a commercial summary sheet for PO submission. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189
